description.value: Nectar Yoga Retreat is a wellness and yoga retreat centre set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island, reached by a 20-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Founded around 2014, it offers overnight cottage stays, hosted yoga and meditation retreats, and group or corporate rentals in a nature-immersed setting. In 2025 the owners added Mist Thermal Sanctuary next door, featuring private sauna and cold plunge experiences in the forest.
